AI Engineer
Acme AI Labs · Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Hybrid)
Posted 2 weeks ago

About the role
Acme AI Labs is building retrieval-augmented generation products for
enterprise customers. We are looking for an AI Engineer (0-2 years of
experience) to design, build, and evaluate production RAG systems.

What you'll do
- Architect retrieval pipelines combining semantic vector search with
  keyword-based methods (BM25)
- Build evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs
- Work with product and consulting teams to ship client-facing AI features

What we're looking for
- Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and agentic workflows
- Experience with hybrid retrieval, chunking strategies, and embedding models
- Strong communication skills; comfort working directly with clients

Nice to have
- Power BI or other analytics tooling
- Experience in pharma or other regulated industries
